source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-linked traits in humans, block for block, with Kitab ki ghalti boxes (PDF 106-108).

blocks.text: X-linked recessive khasiyatein auraton (females) mein mardon se kam hoti hain. Wajah yeh hai ke aurat mein aisi khasiyat sirf tab zahir hoti hai jab us ke dono X chromosomes par recessive allele ho. Jab ke mard mein X par sirf aik allele hi kaafi hai, kyunke Y chromosome par is gene ka allele nahi hota.

Is liye yeh khasiyat har us mard mein zahir hoti hai jis ke paas is ka allele ho. Misalein: muscular dystrophy (muscles ki kamzori aur tootna), red-green colour blindness aur haemophilia (khoon mein clotting factors ki kami).

Agar maa mein khasiyat ho to us ke sab beton mein bhi hogi. Agar maa carrier (heterozygous) ho to us ke 50% bete ise le sakte hain. Agar baap mein khasiyat ho to us ki sab betiyan carrier hongi (kyunke betiyon ko baap ka X milta hai), aur koi beta ise nahi lega (kyunke beton ko baap ka X nahi, Y milta hai).

blocks.alt: Insani shaklein. Carrier maa XRXr aur non-carrier baap XRY. Eggs Xr aur XR; sperm XR aur Y. Lakeerein chaar bachchon tak: betiyan XRXr (carrier) aur XRXR (non-carrier); bete XrY (khasiyat maujood) aur XRY (non-carrier). Key: R X-linked dominant allele, r X-linked recessive allele.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.15: X-linked recessive khasiyaton ki virasat (kitab ki Figure 18.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Carrier maa (XᴿXʳ) aadhe eggs mein Xʳ deti hai. Jis bete ko Xʳ mila us mein khasiyat zahir hai (XʳY), kyunke us ke paas doosra X nahi. Jis beti ko Xʳ mila woh sirf carrier hai (XᴿXʳ), kyunke baap ka Xᴿ use bacha leta hai.

Yeh khasiyatein auraton mein mardon se zyada (taqreeban do guna) aam hain. Misalein: vitamin D-resistant rickets (vitamin D ko theek se istemal na kar pana, jis se haddiyan naram aur kamzor ho jati hain), Rett syndrome (dimagh ki nashonuma ki bimari jis mein bolna khatam ho jata hai, haath baar baar aik hi harkat karte hain aur chalne mein mushkil hoti hai) aur Aicardi syndrome (dimagh ki ghair maamooli nashonuma).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke X-linked dominant khasiyatein auraton aur mardon mein barabar nisbat mein hoti hain. Yeh sahi nahi: aurat ke do X hain, is liye allele rakhne ke do mauqe, aur yeh khasiyatein auraton mein taqreeban do guna aam hain. Kitab ka agla nukta bhi yahi dikhata hai: mutasir baap ki sab betiyan mutasir hoti hain aur koi beta nahi.

Agar X-linked dominant khasiyat maa mein ho aur maa heterozygous ho to us ke 50% bachche ise le sakte hain; agar maa homozygous ho to sab bachche lete hain. Agar baap mein ho to us ki sab betiyan ise leti hain (beti ko baap ka X milta hai) aur koi beta nahi leta (bete ko baap ka X nahi milta).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne likha hai ke X-linked dominant khasiyat wali maa '(homozygous ya heterozygous)' ho to 50% bachche ise le sakte hain. 50% sirf heterozygous maa par sahi hai; homozygous maa har bachche ko dominant allele deti hai, is liye us ke sab bachche mutasir hote hain.

blocks.alt: Insani shaklein. Khasiyat wali maa XRXr aur non-carrier baap XrY. Eggs XR aur Xr; sperm Xr aur Y. Lakeerein chaar bachchon tak: betiyan XRXr (khasiyat maujood) aur XrXr (non-carrier); bete XRY (khasiyat maujood) aur XrY (non-carrier). Key: R X-linked dominant allele, r X-linked recessive allele.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.16: X-linked dominant khasiyaton ki virasat (kitab ki Figure 18.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Y chromosome par X ke muqable mein kaafi kam genes hain, isi liye Y-linked khasiyatein kam milti hain. Y-linked genes ke alleles X chromosome par nahi hote. Aise genes holandric genes (ya hemizygous genes) kehlate hain aur sirf Y chromosome ke non-homologous hisse par hote hain. Y-linked khasiyatein sirf mardon mein aati hain aur sirf baap se bete ko jati hain. Kitab ki misalein: hypertrichosis (kaan ke kinare par baal), porcupine man (jism par seedhe sakht baal) aur paon ki ungliyon ka aapas mein jura hona (webbing of toes).

blocks.alt: Insani shaklein. Non-carrier maa XX aur khasiyat wala baap XYr. Eggs X aur X; sperm X aur Yr. Lakeerein chaar bachchon tak: do betiyan XX (non-carrier) aur do bete XYr (khasiyat maujood). Key: r Y-linked allele.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.17: Y-linked khasiyaton ki virasat (kitab ki Figure 18.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Rang-andha (colour-blind) mard aisi aurat se shadi karta hai jo carrier nahi. Beton aur betiyon ke baare mein kya kaha ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Beton ko maa ka normal X milta hai, is liye koi beta rang-andha nahi hoga. Har beti ko baap ka X milta hai, is liye sab betiyan normal nazar wali carriers hongi.

items: X-linked recessive: mardon mein zyada; carrier maa ke 50% bete mutasir; mutasir baap ki sab betiyan carrier.
X-linked dominant: auraton mein zyada; mutasir baap sab betiyon ko deta hai, beton ko nahi.
Y-linked (holandric) genes: sirf mardon mein, baap se har bete ko.
